newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iranians to sue Germans for chemical help to Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Iranians to sue Germans for chemical help to Iraq.

text.p: Iranians disabled by chemical weapons attacks during Iran's war with Iraq are taking legal action against German firms reported to have helped Iraq produce the banned weapons, the Iranian news agency IRNA reported.

The official agency said in a report late on Monday that a number of disabled people have filed legal cases with courts in Iran. "The war veterans suffering from chemical syndromes have requested the judiciary to proceed with their legal action."
Iran had as far back as 1987 accused West German companies of helping Iraq to produce internationally banned chemical weapons, which Baghdad used during the 1980-88 war with Iran.
